name: Galaxy A24

images.credit: Striker9498, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.SIM: Single SIM (Nano-SIM) or Dual SIM (Nano-SIM, dual stand-by)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 13 with One UI 5.1, Current: Android 16 with One UI 8.5

Display.Display: 6.5 in, Infinity-U Display, 1080 x 2408 px resolution, 20:9 ratio (~406 ppi density), Super AMOLED, 90Hz refresh rate

Cameras.Rear camera: Triple-Camera Setup, Primary: Samsung ISOCELL (S5K)JN1; 50 Megapixel, MP, f/1.8, 27mm, FoV 78.4°, 1/2.76", 0.64μm, PDAF, OIS, Ultrawide: GalaxyCore GC5035; 5 Megapixel, MP, f/2.2, 17mm, FoV 104.3°, 1/5.0", 1.12μm, Macro: GalaxyCore GC02M1; 2 Megapixel, MP, f/2.4, 1/5.0", 1.75μm, fixed focus, Camera features: LED flash, panorama, HDR, Video recording: 1080p@30fps, gyro-EIS
Cameras.Front camera: Sony IMX 258 or Hynix Hi-1339; 13 MP, f/2.2, 25mm (wide), FoV 80.9°, 1/3.06", 1.12μm, Video recording: 1080p@30fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth 5.3, A2DP, LE, A-GPS, GLONASS, GALILEO, BDS
